youtube.baslik: Can an implant be faulty even when all the tests are normal? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: In a hard failure, the internal unit fails, or telemetry and the integrity test are clearly abnormal. A soft failure, by contrast, is a drop in performance or nonauditory symptoms while the tests look normal; defined at a consensus conference in 2005, it is a diagnosis of exclusion, and the external unit, map, medical causes and electrode position are ruled out first.
